mechanism: Precomputed multi-view repository index served as search, navigation and bounded context, reused across tasks
evidence_scope: The key design is to reuse repository-derived state across tasks without collapsing ranked candidates, source locations, and prompt history into one abstraction.
evidence_role: CodeNibis a multi-view data system that makes that measurement possible. It is the first to compile lexical, dense, and structural views of one commit behind a single manifest and source-address contract
